messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: customer oceanic-pay (tenant_id:oceanic-42) experiencing p99 latency > 8s in eu-west-2 dedicated pool dpool-eu2-13. Error rate up, some 504s. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/oceanic-pay
anya (oncall): taking. pinging lexa and mike. starting triage. any immediate customer-facing note? :thinking_face:
mike (sre): looking at dpool-eu2-13. queue_depth spiking on proxy nodes 7,8. GPUs not OOM, CPU ok. lots of short, high-concurrency requests from oceanic-pay frontends. appears tenant-generated burst (token counts normal). logs show repeated reconnects from client agent v2.1.1.
lexa (irt-lead): recommended mitigation: 1) isolate noisy tenant from shared backend, 2) route new requests to warm spare region eu-west-1 (warm pool w/ reserved capacity), 3) enable short-term rate cap at edge for this tenant. Can we perform 1 & 2 now? :point_up:
devon (eng-runtime): can alter routing via control-plane API. prepping command snippets. will stage to canary first. proposed routing change:
```
# route tenant oceanic-42 to fallback-target eu-west-1-warm
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/v1/routing/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTR_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"oceanic-42","target":"eu-west-1-warm","duration":3600}'
```
mike (sre): starting eviction of noisy worker processes on node-07 to free up queue slots. running: `/usr/local/bin/tenant-isolate --tenant oceanic-42 --pool dpool-eu2-13 --mode drain`.
nina (cust-success): pinging customer via support channel now. telling them we detected elevated latency and we're enacting temporary throttles and routing to warm spare. ETA 20m for initial mitigation. will keep them posted.
ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-4872 and linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/INC/Oceanic+Pay+eu2+p99
anya (oncall): mike/devon, once routing change is in canary, share canary id. I'll notify customer of canary and ask them to confirm degraded behaviors persist.
devon (eng-runtime): canary update deployed to 5% of traffic at 177999,display: canary-id=can-772. applying full override in 3m if canary stable.
mike (sre): eviction completed on node-07/08. queue depth on those nodes dropped ~60%. overall p99 moved from 8.6s -> 2.1s during canary. still seeing tail spikes on some requests.
anya (oncall): :thumbsup: good progress. nex step throttle_policy -> set soft-limit 100 rps per tenant for oceanic-42 while we root cause.
devon (eng-runtime): throttle applied at edge: `SET_TENANT_THROTTLE oceanic-42 100` — confirmed.
nina (cust-success): customer acknowledges: they see improvement but intermittent spikes remain. asking for duration and whether this is a product issue or client-side.
lexa (irt-lead): short-term: keep routing override + throttle for 60m, continue logs for client agents to confirm whether reconnects cause burst. long-term: we'll open a post-incident action to evaluate client SDK backoff and queueing.
mike (sre): capturing heap and proxy stats. attaching sample lines: `proxy_queue: before=142 after=38 p99_latency=2100ms`.
devon (eng-runtime): also enabling fallback model for oceanic-pay to quantized variant to reduce per-request overhead. applying: `model_override oceanic-42 -> gpt-lite-q8` for canary. will revert after stabilization.
incident-bot: Status update @here — mitigation in progress: routing override + tenant throttle + model fallback. Customer impact reduced (errors decreased). Next update in 15m.
anya (oncall): monitoring. lexa, mike — please summarize current state for handoff at +45m.
mike (sre): metrics: p95=430ms, p99=1.2s after full routing override and throttle. error rate back to baseline. still tracking occasional 3-4s spikes tied to specific client IP clusters.
nina (cust-success): briefed customer, they've asked for a postmortem and timeline. flagged for priority follow-up with account team.
lexa (irt-lead): noted. will own post-incident action items: SDK backoff, dedicated-proxy autoscaling, tenant isolation playbook update.
anya (oncall): handing off to karim (next-oncall) at 1780003600. summary: oceanic-pay p99 spike caused by tenant-generated burst; actions taken = tenant isolate/evict on dpool-eu2-13, routing override to eu-west-1 warm spare, edge throttle 100rps, model fallback to q8. current status stable (p99 ~1.2s). customer notified and expects postmortem. karim, please maintain throttle for next 60m and coordinate with eng-runtime for rollback plan once stable. linking ticket: INC-2026-4872
karim (next-oncall): acknowledged. taking over monitoring and will escalte to midnight SRE if spikes resume. :ok_hand:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4872 updated: assigned -> karim, status -> monitoring.
incident-bot: Closing note: will convert this thread into a postmortem draft once incident resolved."
